faqs.q: Sec. 18-176. - I.R.C. Section R110.3, Certificate issued.
faqs.a:
Section R110.3. Certificate issued,
is hereby amended by amending the first paragraph to read as follows:
"
R110.3. Certificate issued.
After the building official inspects the building or structure and finds no violations
                  of the provisions of this code or any other applicable policies or laws that are enforced
                  by the department of building safety, the building official shall issue a certificate
                  of occupancy which shall contain the following:"
The remaining numbered provisions of section R110.3 of the I.R.C. shall remain unchanged.
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
